source.section: Schedule 2 line 11 code 601 and PDF pages 19-20 Civil Service Annuity Deduction (PDF page 19: 'The lesser of the amount of taxable civil service annuity income ... or $16,000, Less all amounts of Social Security income and tier 1 and tier 2 Railroad Retirement income ... received by the civil service annuitant'); Schedule 2 lines 5 and 6 (PDF page 17 Lines 5 and 6: 'Indiana does not tax Social Security income or the railroad retirement benefits'); Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000), line 4 (PDF page 25: 1,000 age 65 or older), line 5 (PDF page 25: 500 age 65 or older and IT-40 line 1 under 40,000, or under 20,000 married filing separately); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = federal civil service annuity person 0 9,000.00 + railroad retirement person 0 3,000.00 + IRA distribution person 0 20,000.00 = 32,000.00. Federal taxable income = 32,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 14,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 32,000.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 32,000.00 + 0.00 = 32,000.00. Railroad retirement person 0: deducted in full, 3,000.00 (Schedule 2 line 6). Civil service annuity person 0 (age 66): lesser of the taxable annuity 9,000.00 and 16,000.00 = 9,000.00; less that person's own Social Security received 0.00 and railroad retirement 3,000.00 = 6,000.00. Taking the railroad retirement off the 16,000.00 first would leave 13,000.00 and allow the whole 9,000.00; the booklet takes it off the lesser amount. Schedule 2: line 6 railroad retirement 3,000.00; line 11 code 601 civil service annuity 6,000.00; line 12 total = 9,000.00. IT-40 line 4 = 9,000.00. Line 5 = 32,000.00 - 9,000.00 = 23,000.00. Schedule 3: line 1 1,000.00; line 4 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00; line 5 IT-40 line 1 32,000.00 is under 40,000.00: 1 x 500.00 = 500.00; line 7 total = 2,500.00. IT-40 line 6 = 2,500.00. Line 7 = 23,000.00 - 2,500.00 = 20,500.00. Line 8 = 20,500.00 x 0.03 = 615.00. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 615.00.
